Studio, Woodhead at 4:49
Excel tools and feeds, the APIs page
Data Cloud fed by Aladdin data and analytics
hosting (Azure today; AWS option, H2 2026)
Six pieces make up Studio
the six pieces are: APIs (Aladdin Graph), Event-driven APIs, Aladdin Data Cloud, Aladdin Compute, Aladdin SDK, Developer Portal and Data Dictionary
Aladdin Graph is the whole API layer, not one API
every public specification carries an id of the form agraph.<domain>.<segment>.<group>.v1.<API>
Woodhead names “APIs events” as one part
Diwakar Goel, Global Head of Data, Aladdin
Goel wants “every single transaction ... via an event, via an API”
Aladdin Data Cloud: A managed data store on Snowflake, with Fivetran moving the data
Goel puts its latency at “within 15 minutes”
Aladdin Compute: A hosted space where developers run Python next to their Aladdin data
the SDK has a run mode for “Aladdin Studio Compute sessions”
Aladdin SDK: An open-source Python library that handles login, retries, rate limits, pagination and long-running operations
Eleven add-on packages, one per API domain, are generated from the specifications by BlackRock’s plugin builder
